job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality Python applications using Fast API framework.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.
Develop scalable and efficient algorithms for data processing, machine learning models integration into the application.
Troubleshoot issues and optimize system performance.

Job Requirements :

5.5-9 years of experience in Python development with expertise in Fast API framework.
Strong understanding of generative AI concepts and their implementation in software development.
Proficiency in writing clean, modular, well-documented code adhering to best practices.
